\section{Long Paragraphs}
This first paragraph is written as one very long source line, the way some people write LaTeX when their editor wraps lines softly: it goes on and on, with clauses separated by commas, semicolons; and dashes---like this one---until it has filled several lines of output, and then it keeps going a little longer just to be sure that the single source line maps to many lines of output, which is the case where forward search must return several rectangles for one line of the source.
